summary: - **[PandoraPFAOrg/LCContent#33](https://github.com/PandoraPFAOrg/LCContent/pull/33)** — Adds Pandora particle-flow algorithms for the IDEA option 2 detector. ECAL clusters come in from k4RecCalorimeter, HCAL clusters are seeded from them inside Pandora, and there are ECAL-seeded clustering, forward photon ID, isolated-hit preparation, PFO creation and a dual-readout correction plugin. Two ONNX-based ML algorithms (photon ID and satellite-cluster merging) build only with `LCContent_BUILD_ML=ON`; the package now requires PandoraSDK ≥ 04.00.01.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1690](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1690)** — Sensitive detectors now keep volume-exit state changes even when a short step is removed by the energy filter. Previously such hits stayed open into the next sensor, which produced averaged positions outside the sensor, including spurious hits near z=0.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#124](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/124)** — Fixes the hit covariance in `prepareTrackerHits`, which ignored the hit's own u/v axes. It is now rotated from those axes into the ACTS surface frame. Before the fix, misaligned endcap modules swapped precise and coarse uncertainties, so good forward hits failed the CKF χ² cut and tracks were truncated or lost; barrel modules are unchanged.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#125](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/125)** — Adds an `InitialTrackError_QOverP` property to `CKFTrackingAlg` and `GNNTrackFinder`. It is an absolute q/p error added in quadrature to the relative seed error. This lets high-pT seeds with poor curvature estimates be corrected without letting soft seeds drift into fake high-pT tracks.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#113](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/113)** — `TrackMerger` gains a significance-based matching criterion, and it is now the default. The other matching defaults now follow CLDConfig's `ClonesAndSplitTracksFinder`, so existing configurations change behaviour.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#117](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/117)** — `VTXdigitizerDetailed` now reads sensor thickness from the sensitive volume rather than from ZPlanarData/ZPetalData extensions. This lets it run on compound vertex detectors such as ALLEGRO's; CLD output is verified unchanged.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#116](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/116)** — `GGTFTrackFinder` gains an `EmbeddingCoordinates` property so it can use models trained with different embedding-space dimensions. Extra model output features are tolerated instead of crashing inference.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#112](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/112)** — The GenFit track fitter now resets the global TGeoManager navigator state before each fit. Previously, material lookups on geometry boundaries could depend on previously fitted tracks, making results depend on processing order.

- **[key4hep/k4Gen#66](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/66)** — Fixes three bugs: `EDMToHepMCConverter` set particle energy to the mass. `EDMToHepMCConverter` divided vertex time by c instead of multiplying. `FlatSmearVertex` applied a dz/c time offset instead of dz.

- **[key4hep/k4Gen#62](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/62)** — `HepMCToEDMConverter` now preserves particle order and includes vertex time. This brings ddsim hit outputs from HepMC3 and EDM4hep inputs into agreement.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1699](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1699)** — The calorimeter barrel and endcap surface plugins (DDRec) can now create cylindrical surfaces (symmetry=0) in addition to polygonal ones.

- **[key4hep/k4Bench#241](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Bench/pull/241)** — Nightly reconstruction benchmarks now cover every detector except SiD (ALLEGRO, CLD, IDEA, ILD_FCCee) on Zbb and single-electron samples. Benchmark jobs can now fetch external data files.
